data.title: 初雪 · 铃铛的新绳
data.description: 铃铛的旧绳磨出了毛边。初雪把新绳缓缓穿过小孔，确认结扣不会松开，才把它轻轻放回桌面。
data.action: 为小铃铛穿上一条新绳
data.camera: 近景，双手与铃铛清晰可见
data.promptProse: At a wooden alpine workshop table scattered with braided silver thread and carved bone needles, Saintess Pramanix delicately threads a heavy ceremonial cord through the loop of an antique brass prayer bell. Soft morning light streams through a frosty double-glazed window, illuminating floating wool fibers, traditional Kjerag woven tapestries, and her massive fluffy snow leopard tail curled calmly beside her.
